title: narcissus rupicola subsp. watieri
intro: Narcissus rupicola subsp. watieri, commonly known as the Watieri Rock Narcissus, is a rare, endemic, and protected species of bulbous perennial plant native to the Italian Alps. This plant has been found to have various health benefits, including its antimicrobial and antifungal properties, which make it useful in traditional medicine to treat infections and wounds. The therapeutic actions of Watieri Rock Narcissus include its ability to soothe and calm the nervous system, reducing stress and anxiety. The plant contains bioactive constituents such as alkaloids, glycosides, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal and therapeutic properties.
